content: What's a good exercise for my upper chest?

Incline Barbell Bench Press is the king for upper chest — it directly targets the clavicular head of the pecs and will carry over nicely to your flat bench 100kg goal! You could also do Incline Dumbbell Press or Low-to-High Cable Flyes as solid alternatives. Want me to add any of these to today's workout? 💪
Sounds good, add it to today's workout.
